term: nonnecessary root of the selected relation
definition: Using the shared ActualRoot predicate (DEF-ACTUAL-ROOT), NonnecessaryRootAt m w says ∃ x, ActualRoot m w x ∧ ¬ NecessaryAt m.ontic w x. The fixed individual x does not exist at every world accessible from w. This is a negated universal and supplies no witness world lacking x. It is roothood of the selected relation only; an abstract, absent or unmodelled ground or explanation remains possible.
note: Analyst's vocabulary for #553: 'uncaused relative to R', not 'uncaused absolutely' or 'absurd'. Would be sourced only by an account of what a root of real grounding or causing is (#505, #545).
